notes.title: NEW MONSTER PITS 👹🕳️
notes.content:
Commanders! 🫡

The wait is over. After weeks of work, we’re dropping a major update with two new bombshells that will shake up the battlefield! 💣💥

Monsters can now emerge from underground pits! 👹🕳️

Until now, dead ends would remain empty for the entirety of a game.

That's over now: when a dead end is created, it automatically fills with a monster pit! We’ve introduced more than a dozen unique pits with special powers for even more gameplay!

Two new buildings to bend luck in your favor! 🤞🍀

The amplifier and attenuator are making their debut in the game. With these special buildings, you can now make the appearance of a particular building more or less likely. Even more strategy and control in store for you, commander! 🔀

And with that comes a brand-new tool: live damage ranking. 📊✅

With this tool, one click is all it takes to see which towers are carrying your defense, and find the ones that are underperforming. 

Full patch details below: ⬇️

Additions / Improvements: ✨
- Foes Pits now appears when a path leads to a fully enclosed dead-end.
- Two new buildings, Attenuator and Amplifier, allow to influence the Reinforcement rewards
- New doctrines Attenuator deployment I&II, Amplifier deployment I&II, granting Attenuators and Amplifiers
- New platform shapes! Irregular platforms can be gained through doctrines, Pits and more.
- Damage display widget
- Grenadiers and tank leaving the battlefield by an Entry point are now fully respawned from HQ (no more damage loss)
- New doctrine Pit Surveillance
- New doctrine Atypical delivery
- Newly spawned Neutral buildings are glowing until next wave or activated
- It is now possible to click on elements while reviewing your final position in game over
- Random commander option now allows to specify a faction
- Add Disable Screenshake Option

Balance Changes: ⚖️
- Increased Epsilon Axiom HP bonus from 15% to 25%
- Decreased Imperial fervor bonus from 2% to 1%
- Omega emitter now gets +5% Damage each traveled square (resets each shot)
- Reworked Lieutenant Delven, now a specialist of Pits
- Super heavy pulse cannon - Overloading cells now gives +300% Damage instead of 600% but -does not cause a Reload speed malus
- Experimental heavy pulse - Focused energy now gives +300% Damage instead of 600% but does not cause a Reload speed malus
- Increased Experimental heavy pulse - Collective experiment rate of fire bonus from 10% to 25% 

Bug fixes: 👾
- Fixed an issue removing Detection from buildings
- Fixed an issue giving a Zone impossible to place
- Fixed an issue with Lions of Ravelski resulting in a never ending wave with no foes
- Fixed an issue in Endless, triggering three reveals at once
- Fixed an issue sometimes removing Reload speed bonuses when upgrading to a new weapon
- Fixed a condition which caused progression loss in rare situations

Here’s how to create a pit:
https://i.imgur.com/3pSH29t.png

notes.title: ⚔️PATCH NOTE 1.37⚔️
notes.content:
Commanders! 🫡

This update mostly brings performance improvements to the battlefield. ⚙️💥

We have dedicated our recent efforts to optimizing game performance:
✅ Fewer slowdowns
✅ Faster path calculation
✅ A much smoother Endless mode, even with massive enemy waves
✅ And most importantly: The speed-up option (speed x3) now works much more smoothly at all times, without affecting the effectiveness of your units in terms of targeting and damage.

As always, we have also taken the opportunity to fix a few bugs and fine-tune the balancing. ⚖️👾

Thank you for your patience and commitment. It's thanks to your support that we can continue to move the game in the right direction. 🫶 In fact, many of your comments have already been taken into account and incorporated into our ongoing improvements. 💭🛠️

Full patch details below:

Additions / Improvements: ✨
- Specific Defeat screen for Endless mode

Balance Changes: ⚖️
- Increased Durendal position - Flarium shells damage bonus from 150% to 225%
- Increased Durendal position - Exposed elements damage bonus from 50% to 75%
- Increased Scout hideout expertise discovery from 5 to 10
- Increased Super heavy pulse defense expertise shield bonus from 10% to 15%
- Increased Electric arc cannon expertise shield bonus from 5% to 15%
- Decreased Electric arc cannon - Overheated charges cost from 700 to 550
- Decreased Sanction cannon - Flak shells cost from 800 to 750
- Decreased Omega emitter - Optimized coils cost from 450 to 325
- Minor balancing changes for Endless mode above wave 60

Bug fixes: 👾
- Fixed an issue with Imperial Barracks not giving damage bonus while adjacent to HQ
- Fixed an issue with Bastion Efficiency II not being acquirable
- Fixed an issue with having lower damage while having low FPS or during Speed-Up
- Fixed an issue with long Foe spawn times during late game play

notes.title: ⚔️PATCH NOTE 1.31⚔️
notes.content:
On All (Battle)Fronts! 🫡

The battle on multiple fronts is still raging: Commanders have often relied on drawing the enemy into a single kill zone. Now, with this update, a new era is coming: Defending across several fronts becomes just as viable, opening the door to new strategies and more dynamic gameplay. 🗺️

Each faction has received a major boost to help them handle pressure from all sides, and we’ll continue refining this feature so that every approach feels rewarding, whether through new mechanics, balance changes, or other improvements. 🎯🛡️

You’ll also notice UI upgrades, including a brand new counter for Fronts and Entry Points. And of course, a round of bug fixes to keep things running smoothly. ⚙️

Full patch details below:

Additions / Improvements: ✨
- UI now displays Battlefront and Entry points counts (Glossary removed from the pause menu and added directly to the new in-game UI widget, as tooltips)
- Alpha Lecos enemy now has a different model than the regular Lecos
- Steel factory’s colors changed to be more easily distinguishable from Advanced Steel factory

Balance Changes: ⚖️
- Officers Quarters - Underground train now reads “HQ +1 Range per Battlefront”
- Officers Quarters - Company bugler now reads “Infantry HP increase by 40 per Battlefront”
- Imperial Stronghold - Underground garage now reads “Each wave, spawns 1 Tank Auctoritas per Battlefront. Then 1 every 10 sec”
- Barricade - Reinforced frame now reads “+125% HP, +25% per Battlefront”
- Increased Commissar Anysia’s Grenadier production from every other wave to each wave
- Threxid now has Overwatch power, increasing reroll costs by 250
- Decreased Medacris HP from 300 to 280

Bug fixes: 👾
- Fixed a visual issue, displaying buildings merged with platforms
- Fixed an issue with Reload Speed on Super Heavy Pulse Cannon

notes.title: ⚔️PATCH NOTE 1.27⚔️
notes.content:
Heavy reinforcements this week, Commanders!🫡

🎮 Gameplay: Threats are now revealed one wave earlier! That’s one precious extra wave to get organized, tweak your strategy, and prepare for what’s coming.

📡 Tactical Intel: Weapons stats are finally here! Enable the option in your settings and dive into the numbers like the battle-hardened strategist you are.📊📈

🔧 Performance: We noticed Endless Mode might be demanding on some CPUs under certain conditions. A first wave of optimizations is now live to improve smoothness and performance. This is just the beginning. 🚀

As always, more balance tweaks based on your feedback, bugs squashed, and more surprises on the way.

Thanks for your unwavering support!

Hold the line, never surrender! 🪖

Detailed change list:

- Threat reveal notification in Endless

Balance Changes:⚖️

notes.title: ⚔️PATCH NOTE 1.20⚔️
notes.content:
🫡 Hi Commanders,

🚨 This is a major update, the first of many to come!

We’re kicking things off with our initial improvements to the Endless Mode, and to the Codex. This is just the beginning, and we’re eager to hear your thoughts as we continue refining the experience.

♾️ Endless Mode: Improved!

We’ve reworked Endless Mode to offer larger battlefields and longer sessions, while making the pacing more gradual, less punishing, and ultimately more rewarding. It’s still a challenge, but now it’s a more strategic one.

📖 Codex & Upgrades

We worked on improving the Codex. You can now easily hover over a building to preview its upgrade paths. Finally, the Codex is now also accessible in-game, letting you quickly consult it before placing a tower or choosing a reward. 🧠

Full patch details below: 

Additions / Improvements: ✨
- New Endless mode
- Codex now available in game
- Codex now displays Buildings upgrades on mouse-hover
- Clearer tooltip explanation for Unseen codex element vs. Locked element
- Add a default Frame limit option if Vsync is Off
- Add Visual Feedback on HQ Damage

Balance Changes: ⚖️
- Increased Rampart silo missiles travel speed
- Electric arc cannon High-grade capacitor now reads “+4 Range per Battlefront”
- Decreased Electric arc cannon Paleotech capacitor cost to 1 from 2
- Increased Xeno-prognosis Scrap warp generator doctrine gain to 6 from 3
- Decreased Xeno-prognosis Scrap warp generator cost to 150 from 250
- Increased Breeding grounds population to 50 from 30
- Increased Lead by example damage bonus to 10% from 5%
- Decreased Armored staging ground Tracing Barrage LMG cost decreased to 200 from 350
- Increased Armored staging ground Tracing Barrage LMG bonus range to 3 from 2
- Frontier modifier Frozen logistics now triggers only each other wave

Bug fixes: 👾
- Fixed an issue displaying towers below ground level
- Fixed an incorrect interaction between Z23 Reinforced Structure and the amount of Battlefronts
- Fixed an issue resulting in foes’ spawn being diminished

We’re far from done, there's still plenty more to come, and we're going to continue listening to you and improving the game!

notes.title: ⚔️PATCH NOTE 1.14⚔️
notes.content:
Commanders! 🫡

Today’s update focuses on resolving issues with how the game saves and processes unlock conditions for heroes, towers, doctrines, and badges. These changes are aimed at preventing incorrect unlocks, or worse, not receiving them at all. 🔓

You should no longer encounter problems like receiving the wrong badge for the difficulty you completed, or not receiving a badge despite meeting the requirements. 🎖️

We’ve also updated how the game saves your progress to reduce the risk of data loss when quitting the game, including abrupt exits. Your progression should now be reliably preserved. 💾✅

This update lays the groundwork for several big changes coming soon, including a major rework of how difficulty scales in Endless Mode. Our goal is to enable larger-scale battles and offer deeper strategic possibilities. Before building on top of the current systems, we wanted to ensure the game’s foundation is solid and reliable. 🧱🛡️

Thank you for your support and valuable feedback, it helps us focus on what truly matters. We’re excited for what’s ahead and can’t wait to share more with you in the next updates! 🚀

Full patch details below:


Additions / Improvements: ✨
- Tooltips of Neutral buildings now directly display their effects
- Advanced Imperial barracks colors now match with their weapons
- New bomber sound effect


Bug fixes: 👾
- Fixed an issue when quitting the game could result in an unlock never being completed
- Fixed an issue where a properly unlocked Foe, Doctrine, or Building was not properly being unlocked.
- Cleaned up display of commanders having Frontier 19 badge while having never played any Frontier mode
- Fixed an issue resulting in progression being lost (this fix does NOT retroactively restore saved progressions)

notes.title: ⚔️PATCH NOTE 1.11⚔️
notes.content:
🫡 Greetings Commanders!

Today’s update delivers many improvements, with a primary focus on fixing an issue that affected badge rewards in Frontier mode.

Many of you have reported not receiving the correct badge after completing expeditions in Frontier mode... and thanks to your detailed reports, we tracked down the culprit and fixed this annoying bug. 👾🛠️

While we can't retroactively grant past badges, we deeply appreciate your dedication and hope you enjoy unlocking new achievements from here on out!

On a lighter note, Ctrekoz on Discord pointed out that Warden Gerhard’s ability “Anti-tank warfare” was lacking a bit of flair (and, well… actual tanks), so we knew it was time for a rename!

Without missing a beat, Colonel Astor launched a community vote to choose a new name - and it was Alacarin’s suggestion that came out on top! 🏆

The ability now goes by the name of : “Imperial Supervision” - perfectly grim, just like Gerhard himself. ^^

We sincerely appreciate your continued feedback and engagement - it truly helps guide our work in making the game more balanced, polished, and enjoyable for all players! 🤝

- Increased Iron Dragoons Main Headquarters HP to 2000 from 1750

🪖Fixed an issue with Durendal losing its explosion damage
🪖Fixed various text display issues
🪖Fixed various sound issue during collisions
🪖Fixed an issue with landmines not correctly slowing foes when the Scout hideout was upgraded to gain Slow

We know you've been waiting for better translations, and we truly appreciate your patience! If you spot anything that could be improved, please let us know. Thank you for your support, and stay strong, Soldiers! 🫡
